name: CalibrationShellBothWays
description: A box shelled with `direction: "both"`, the case that needs the kBothSidesShellDirection enum and so could not be built at all until 2026-09-03: the constants table asked Inventor for kBothShellDirection, a name it has never had, and the server refused rather than guessing. The refusal was correct and it hid the fact that nothing had ever exercised this path. Run at last, it settled what `both` means, exactly: the wall straddles the original face, half in and half out, so this part is a solid grown 1 mm on four sides and the base less a cavity inset 1 mm -- 6.2 x 4.2 x 2.1 minus 5.8 x 3.8 x 1.9 is 12.808 cm^3, and the shell removes 35.192. Inventor removed 35.1920. The simulator's exact branch is the inside case, so `both` falls to its surface-area estimate and reads 13.6% low, inside the tolerance a shell is allowed.

parameters.name: wall
parameters.comment: split either side of the face
